import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import api from '../lib/api';
import Header from '../components/Header';
import NoteForm from '../components/NoteForm';
import NoteList from '../components/NoteList';

export default function NotesPage() {
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    api
      .get('/api/notes')
      .then((res) => {
        if (active) setNotes(res.data ?? []);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (active) setError(err?.response?.data?.detail ?? 'Failed to load notes');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (active) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-6 text-center text-gray-500">
        Loading notes…
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-6 text-center text-red-600">
        {error}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="h-screen flex flex-col">
      <Header />
      <main className="flex-1 flex flex-col md:flex-row">
        <div className="md:w-1/2 xl:w-1/3 p-6">
          <NoteForm />
        </div>
        <div className="md:w-1/2 xl:w-2/3 p-6">
          <NoteList notes={notes} />
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
